$comment: The hero art, its true pixel size, and whether anything references it.
Two things read this file and they must not be allowed to disagree.
scripts/optimize-images.mjs encodes every entry marked encode, and fails
the build if a width or height here does not match the PNG on disk or if
a source in this directory has no entry at all. components/Picture.tsx
reads the same numbers to write width, height and the srcSet candidate
descriptors, which is why they have to be true: a candidate advertised as
1536w that is really 1024w makes the browser pick the wrong one, and a
wrong aspect ratio makes the layout jump when the bytes land.
encode:false is not a mistake. cta-atmosphere and sage-noise are in the
repository and referenced by nothing in app/, components/, lib/ or the
stylesheet: 3.5MB that used to deploy to no purpose. They stay here in
case they are wanted, and are simply not encoded or served.
